reviewer_role: Separate read-only independent critic; no implementation edits
review_scope: Havenline reference-acceptance policy and forward tooling only
aggregation_rule: Minimum; no averaging; every mandatory check must pass

mandatory_checks.name: Final candidate identity
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Corrected 63-file freeze verified before and after the final packaging checks.

mandatory_checks.name: Reference threshold and interim boundary
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Every declared relevant final dimension requires at least 9.9 without rounding; 9.5 reference evidence is interim only.

mandatory_checks.name: Existing stronger visual requirements
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: The mandatory dimensions of C1/C2/C3/C4/C5/C11 retain exact 10; ordinary other specialist dimensions retain 9.5 unless a stronger rule applies.

mandatory_checks.name: Mandatory checks and missing evidence
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: No averaging, outvoting, score normalization, missing evidence or known unresolved required defects can authorize final approval.

mandatory_checks.name: Frozen requirements and review identity
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Policy identity, candidate, task, declared reference dimensions, complete evidence index and original independent reviewer records are bound and checked.

mandatory_checks.name: Strict original dispositions
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Explicit non-PASS, interim, historical, false/nonboolean pass flags, duplicate JSON keys and invalid/nonfinite score values block current final approval.

mandatory_checks.name: C1/C2 visual evidence
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Valid distinct-view fixtures pass; coherent relabeling of identical image bytes as multiple views fails for both lanes.

mandatory_checks.name: C5 motion evidence
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Static specialist is explicitly interim-only. Final external model review requires actual decoded media, full cycle/transition ranges and required coverage.

mandatory_checks.name: C6 performance producer and consumer
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Original independent scores are preserved; exact measured supplement and valid finite metrics are required. Score-only terminal transport is blocked.

mandatory_checks.name: C9 deterministic producer and consumer
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Task/index are bound before execution; the consumer checks the current canonical attack matrix, assertions, protocol and actual harness record.

mandatory_checks.name: Forward closure and authority
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Current signoff, effective dependencies, invalidations and required critic union are enforced; generic status edits and historical exports cannot manufacture approval.

mandatory_checks.name: Current/discovered project roots
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Active scope, project identity and actual dependencies are bound. Level1 is covered; unused preserved Godot content does not independently decide a scoped current signoff.

mandatory_checks.name: Artifact bytes and source provenance
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Required raw reports, inputs and media are read and validated; frozen integration media use the selected Git bytes rather than substituted workspace files.

mandatory_checks.name: Historical preservation
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: 70 task definitions/dependencies/statuses, 20 files inside the dated reference-refresh package, protected registries and 11 original receipt files/14 bindings are preserved.

mandatory_checks.name: T12 lifecycle semantics
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: The pre-disposition aggregate wrapper is separately validated and remains non-approving; individual final critic rows require explicit PASS and boolean passed=true.

mandatory_checks.name: Packaging and deployment limits
mandatory_checks.evidence_summary: Both scope and freeze helpers reject Python cache artifacts. No game/runtime/assets/archive/workflow changes or current game approval are included.

verification.forward_policy_consistency: Independently passed before packaging-only correction; production policy and validator code unchanged by that correction

packaging_lineage.declared_delta: Remove three generated package cache files; add rejection in freeze_snapshot.py and validate_scope.py; retain publication-preflight event in VALIDATION_HISTORY.json
packaging_lineage.independent_delta_review: Final helper source inspection, final digest before/after, four cache-injection negative checks and 15 preservation checks
packaging_lineage.production_and_test_content_unchanged: Builder declaration; scope and final source review consistent with the declared packaging-only correction. Earlier test/probe receipt identities were preserved, not rewritten.

limitations: No current game, APK, aesthetic fidelity, animation, audio listening, device or real performance certification is provided.
Source/media validation cannot mechanically prove truthful independent observation or aesthetic similarity; actual required independent review remains mandatory.
Tests use synthetic fixtures and actual decoding of fixture media; they are not genuine game approval records.
T12 cross-record tests use an explicitly synthetic bundle identity because historical consolidated workflows are inactive; no full workflow environment is certified.
Live external reviewer services, all legacy architecture/workflow suites, remote publication and active-branch adoption were not certified by this critic.
The 207-test suite and 28 probes predate only the final packaging correction; their original freeze identity is retained.
